Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
fix(invoice-numbers): correct invoice number generation and renumber existing invoices

Fixed critical bug where invoice numbers were all showing "REQ-10" due to alphabetical string sorting instead of numerical sorting in the generateNextInvoiceNumber function.

Root Cause:
- The function used `orderBy: { invoiceNumber: ''desc'' }` which sorts strings alphabetically
- String sorting: "REQ-9" > "REQ-56" > "REQ-10" > "REQ-1" (incorrect)
- This caused the function to always find "REQ-9" as the "latest" and generate "REQ-10" for every new invoice

Changes:
- Updated generateNextInvoiceNumber() to fetch all invoices and find the true maximum number numerically
- Created migration script (fix-invoice-numbers.ts) to renumber all existing invoices sequentially
- Successfully renumbered 71 existing invoices from REQ-1 to REQ-71 based on creation date
- New invoices will now correctly increment from REQ-72 onwards

Testing:
- Ran migration script: 71 invoices renumbered successfully
- Next invoice will be REQ-72

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
